title: GKE dynamic slicing for higher resilience, and efficiency for TPUs
summary: Running large-scale AI workloads on TPU and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) requires infrastructure that adapts as fast as your models change. To help, dynamic slicing decouples logical TPU slice formation from physical nodepool provisioning.
